title: Finite-coefficient ordinary curve cohomology
statement: With A, Omega, ell, N and the normalized coefficient map as in [lem-pur-rank-one-finite-kummer-generator], the coordinate class is an A-basis in degree one on the punctured line; positive derived evaluations on the affine line vanish, those on the punctured line vanish in degrees at least two, and degree-zero restriction is invertible.

proof.text: A primitive root identifies the finite Tate line with the constant A sheaf via scalar-extension adjunctions. The adopted source library proves higher vanishing for all finite abelian groups killed by m using finite abelian group decomposition. Transport these vanishings through the module/abelian, represented evaluation/Ext and open-object/global cohomology comparisons.

For a connected etale object the constant-section sheafification map is bijective: the mono into point functions identifies a section with a locally constant function, hence a constant function. Both curves are connected. Naturality of constant sections therefore makes their restriction an isomorphism. The right-derived degree-zero comparison transports it to degree-zero derived restriction.
Apply the separately normalized coordinate-generator theorem for the remaining degree-one assertion.

theorem finite_kummer_cohomology
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (ℓ N : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (hℓΩ : IsUnit (ℓ : Ω)) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hA : ((ℓ ^ N : ℕ) : A) = 0)
    (hm : IsUnit ((ℓ ^ N : ℕ) : Γ(Line (Spec (.of Ω)), ⊤)))
    (f : (Line (Spec (.of Ω))).rootsOfUnitySheaf (ℓ ^ N) ⟶
      (Etale.moduleAbelianForget A (Line (Spec (.of Ω)))).obj
        (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateSheaf A (ℓ ^ N) (Line (Spec (.of Ω))) hA 1))
    (hf : ∀ V z, f.hom.app V z =
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A (ℓ ^ N) (Line (Spec (.of Ω))) hA V 1 z) :
    let X := Line (Spec (.of Ω))
    let F := Scheme.finiteEtaleTateSheaf A (ℓ ^ N) X hA 1
    let κ := kummerClass A X (openObject (Spec (.of Ω))) F (ℓ ^ N) hm f
    (∃ τ : ModuleCat.of A A ≅
        ((sections X.smallEtaleTopology A (openObject (Spec (.of Ω)))).rightDerived 1).obj F,
      τ.hom 1 = κ (coordinateUnit (Spec (.of Ω)))) ∧
    (∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero
      (((sections X.smallEtaleTopology A (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).rightDerived q).obj F)) ∧
    (∀ q : ℕ, 2 ≤ q → IsZero
      (((sections X.smallEtaleTopology A (openObject (Spec (.of Ω)))).rightDerived q).obj F)) ∧
    IsIso ((NatTrans.rightDerived
      ((sheafSections X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).map
        (restriction (Spec (.of Ω))).op) 0).app F)
